description: Bounded public-safe projection derived from identified CoCivium design and test artifacts. Not live telemetry, not universal coverage.

nodes.title: Human-owned continuity
nodes.detail: Fewer provider-specific tabs without abandoning recoverable evidence, privacy, or explicit consent.

nodes.title: Virtual sessions
nodes.detail: Durable session identity, many logical projections, few temporary runtime embodiments. Published architectural proposal, not live federation.

nodes.title: Evidence & lineage
nodes.detail: Exact source identity, hashes, uncertainty, and separate proof of local discovery, landing and receiver pickup.

nodes.title: Privacy & authority
nodes.detail: Selection does not authorize reading private data or writing elsewhere. A public pointer is not a receiver ACK.

nodes.title: CoMap relations
nodes.detail: One typed relation graph can be projected as a map, quiet surface, evidence trail or portable data capsule.

nodes.title: Predictive cursor
nodes.detail: Local opt-in text completion rendered after the caret. Suggestions do not become instructions or actions until explicitly accepted.

nodes.title: CoOrb / ambient
nodes.detail: A future quiet desktop, wallpaper, CoBar or screensaver may view the same data. Browser preview is not native deployment.

nodes.title: CoVIA & nodes
nodes.detail: Dedicated CoVIA and node/site delivery routes lack confirmed receiver ACKs for this work. No fan-out is performed.

nodes.title: Models on demand
nodes.detail: Claude, Pi, and local Llama/Ollama are optional execution choices, subject to real availability, permission, cost and independent tests.

receivers.label: GitHub public discovery
receivers.notes: Repository files can be fetched by consenting readers. No specific CoMapPulse R0 receiver uptake is shown.

receivers.label: Gmail / existing relations
receivers.notes: Recent outreach exists; no new email in this offline prototype.

receivers.label: CoVIA dedicated transport
receivers.notes: A CoVIA relationship is not a verified delivery mechanism.

receivers.label: .nodes / nodes
receivers.notes: No confirmed authorized subscription endpoint or receiver readproof.

receivers.label: .sites / sites
receivers.notes: No confirmed authorized publication adapter or uptake.
